insights.summary: During the discussion, Vineet and Khush explored various strategies to enhance their digital marketing efforts. They emphasized the importance of using technology for lead generation, tracking email engagements, and creating effective marketing materials. Actions were proposed to streamline processes, including creating storyboards for visual content and automating follow-up emails. They also addressed potential risks regarding lead data quality and the necessity for clarity in their marketing approach.
